note: The independent semantic-judge run quoted in docs/UX-PARITY.md. The state is curated, not measured — the judge reads text, not pixels — so each direction carries a hand-written description of its capture's chrome, reviewed alongside the PNG, plus the offline design-language fingerprint. tools/compare/parity-judge.mjs re-runs this fixture against the TypeSafe Jev model (needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY); tests/compare/parity-judge.test.mjs pins the docs to it. `recorded.fidelity` is the judge's rubric score on a 0–10 scale, derived from the mean legend index (recorded.fidelityIndex) by interpolating the even-numbered levels.
targets:
TARGET PRODUCT UIs (independent reference):
- GitHub UI: dark top bar #25292e; white canvas; blue link #0969da; primary action green. Repository navigation is a HORIZONTAL tab row under the repository name. Metadata lives in a RIGHT-HAND "About" sidebar. Repo nav words: Code, Pull requests, Actions, Insights, Projects. File list columns: Name / Last commit / Last update. Logged-out top-bar words: "Platform, Solutions, Resources, Open Source, Enterprise, Pricing", "Sign in", "Sign up".
- GitLab UI: light top bar #fbfafd; white canvas; blue link #1068bf; accent #1f75cb with an orange brand mark. Repository navigation is a VERTICAL GROUPED left sidebar. Metadata is a FULL-WIDTH "Project information" block above the content. Repo nav words: Repository, Merge requests, CI/CD, Analytics, Issue boards. Merge requests are marked !N. Logged-out top-bar words: "Why GitLab, Pricing, Explore", "Register", "Sign in", a "Search or go to..." field.
- Bitbucket UI: blue top bar #0049b0; flat vertical sidebar; repo nav words Source, Pull requests, Pipelines.
